d: The WPL 2027 mini-auction in Kochi produced magic with 15-year-old Uma Kashvi becoming the youngest player ever bought and Nazma Khan landing a dream deal with Jemimah Rodrigues' Delhi Capitals. But behind the emotional headlines lies a stark reality as 121 out of 150 shortlisted players went unsold, leaving world-class stars like Chamari Athapaththu, Titas Sadhu, and Sophia Dunkley without a contract. With viewership skyrocketing by 142% to 370 million viewers and franchises like CSK and Punjab Kings eager to invest, has the Women’s Premier League outgrown its 5-team container? Rupha…
